{{Nihongo|'''Kunio Shiota'''|塩田 邦郎|Shiota Kunio|born August 19, 1950}} is a Japanese [[List of life sciences|life scientist]] specializing in [[biochemistry]] and [[epigenetics]]. He is a Professor Emeritus at [[University of Tokyo]] and a former Guest Senior Researcher at [[Waseda University]].

== Biography ==
He graduated from [[Kagoshima Prefectural Konan High School]] in 1969<ref name=UT>{{Cite web |url=https://www.a.u-tokyo.ac.jp/seminar/yousisyu/42-yousisyu.pdf |script-title=ja:東京大学農学部公開セミナー 第42回「未来を創る農学　未来を支える農学」講演要旨集 |language=ja |publisher=Faculty of Agriculture, University of Tokyo |date=2017-01-12 |accessdate=2021-11-11}}</ref> and from Department of Veterinary Sciences, Faculty of Agriculture, [[University of Miyazaki]] in 1973.{{R|UT}}<ref name=RM>{{Cite web |url=https://researchmap.jp/read0007600/ |script-title=ja:塩田 邦郎 |language=ja |website=reserchmap |publisher=Japan Science and Technology Agency |accessdate=2021-11-11}}</ref> In 1979, he completed Department of Veterinary Medical Sciences, Graduate School of Agriculture, [[University of Tokyo]] and got Ph.D. in agriculture.{{R|UT}} After he completed the graduate school, he joined the [[Takeda Pharmaceutical Company]].{{R|UT}} In 1987, He retired the company and became an associate professor at University of Tokyo Graduate School of Agricultural and Life Sciences (Department of Animal Resource Sciences and Department of Veterinary Medical Sciences).{{R|UT}} He received the Japanese Society of Veterinary Science Award for 1996.{{R|RM}}

He became a professor at University of Tokyo Graduate School of Agricultural and Life Sciences (Department of Animal Resource Sciences and Department of Veterinary Medical Sciences) in 1998.{{R|UT}} He also served as adjunct professors at [[National Institute of Genetics]],<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.nig.ac.jp/anniversary/70th/images/70thsoshiki.pdf |script-title=ja:国立遺伝学研究所創立70周年 その組織の変遷をたどる |language=ja |publisher=National Institute of Genetics |accessdate=2021-11-11}}</ref> [[Juntendo University]] and [[Kagoshima University]].{{R|RM}} In 2013, Kunio Shiota and Koji Hayakawa's research team at University of Tokyo succeeded in the generation of [[orexin]] neurons from [[pluripotent stem cells]] (mouse embryonic stem cells) for the first time in the world.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.a.u-tokyo.ac.jp/topics/2013/20130502-3.html |script-title=ja:多能性幹細胞からオレキシン神経細胞の作出に成功（東京大学大学院農学生命科学研究科 プレスリリース） |language=ja |publisher=Graduate School of Agricultural and Life Sciences, University of Tokyo |date=2013-05-02 |accessdate=2021-11-11}}</ref>

In 2016, he was given the title of Professor Emeritus at University of Tokyo<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.u-tokyo.ac.jp/content/400042744.pdf |script-title=ja:東京大学「平成28年度名誉教授一覧」 |language=ja |publisher=University of Tokyo |date=2016-06-24 |accessdate=2021-11-11}}</ref> and became a Guest Senior Researcher at [[Waseda University]] Research Institute for Science and Engineering.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://up.n-genetics.com/sp_contents/column_shiota/3835/ |title=エピジェネティクスの交差点（東京大学名誉教授 塩田邦郎先生コラム） 第一回 エピジェネティクスって？ (in Japanese) |access-date=12 November 2021 |archive-date=10 November 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191110091610/https://up.n-genetics.com/sp_contents/column_shiota/3835/ |url-status=bot: unknown }}</ref>
